messages.author: 6f2dbf739f071b57
messages.subject: biOps package requires libtiff
parts:
The biOps package cannot be used since it requires libtiff which is not installed.

checking for tiff.h... no
configure: WARNING: Can't find libtiff header
checking for TIFFOpen in -ltiff... no
Try static libs needed on OS X
checking for TIFFOpen in -ltiff... no
Error: Could not find libtiff.
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 3165314 failed: Error building image: Error building biOps (0.2.2). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted


Is it possible to have libtiff on these instances, or easily build "biOps" without using libtiff?

Thanks
